trace.final:
checkout-api is rolled back to v2.3.0 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), and it is healthy again with an error rate of 0.002, down from 0.18.

- **Rollback:** v2.3.1 was failing health checks, and v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy. v2.3.0 was the most recent release that had been healthy, so I rolled back to it. No change-manager approval was needed because v2.3.0 had already run healthy in production.
- **Incident:** I opened SEV2 incident INC-0001 for checkout-api, which paged the on-call engineer. The summary describes the rollback and asks for v2.3.1 and v2.3.1-rc to be investigated before they are released again. The first attempt to open it timed out, so I retried with the same idempotency key. That returned a single incident, so there should be no duplicate.
